hmo.name: Rasa Advantage HMO
hmo.network: HMO: you must use in-network providers, except for emergency care, urgent care when you are outside the service area, and dialysis when you are temporarily outside the service area. You need a referral from your primary care provider (PCP) to see a specialist.
hmo.out_of_network: Not covered, except emergency care, urgent care when you are outside the service area, and out-of-area dialysis.

medical.emergency_room: $125 copay per visit, anywhere in the United States. The copay is waived if you are admitted to the hospital within 24 hours.
medical.inpatient_hospital: $295 copay per day for days 1 to 5, then $0 for the rest of the stay
medical.skilled_nursing: $0 per day for days 1 to 20, $203 per day for days 21 to 100
medical.telehealth: $0 copay for a virtual visit with an in-network provider
medical.diabetic_supplies: $0 copay for glucose monitors and test strips from preferred brands
medical.acupuncture: $20 copay per visit, for chronic low back pain only: up to 12 visits in 90 days, and up to 20 visits a year

pharmacy.deductible: $0 for tiers 1 and 2; $250 for tiers 3, 4 and 5

ppo.name: Rasa Advantage PPO
ppo.monthly_premium: $39, in addition to your Medicare Part B premium
ppo.max_out_of_pocket: $7,900 a year for in-network services, and $11,500 a year for in-network and out-of-network services combined
ppo.network: PPO: you can see any provider who accepts Medicare. You pay less with in-network providers. You do not need a referral to see a specialist.
ppo.out_of_network: Covered at a higher cost: 40% coinsurance for most services. Emergency care costs the same in and out of network.

medical.specialist: $45 copay per visit in-network; 40% coinsurance out-of-network
medical.emergency_room: $125 copay per visit, anywhere in the United States. The copay is waived if you are admitted to the hospital within 24 hours.
medical.inpatient_hospital: $325 copay per day for days 1 to 5, then $0 for the rest of the stay (in-network)
medical.skilled_nursing: $0 per day for days 1 to 20, $203 per day for days 21 to 100 (in-network)
medical.colonoscopy: $0 copay for a screening colonoscopy in-network
medical.telehealth: $0 copay for a virtual visit with an in-network provider
medical.diabetic_supplies: $0 copay for glucose monitors and test strips from preferred brands
medical.mental_health: $25 copay per individual therapy visit in-network
medical.acupuncture: $25 copay per visit, for chronic low back pain only: up to 12 visits in 90 days, and up to 20 visits a year

pharmacy.deductible: $0 for tiers 1 and 2; $250 for tiers 3, 4 and 5

program.part_d_out_of_pocket_cap: $2,100 in 2026. When your out-of-pocket drug costs reach $2,100, you pay $0 for covered Part D drugs for the rest of the year.
program.insulin: Covered insulin costs no more than $35 for a one-month supply, and the drug deductible does not apply.
program.prescription_payment_plan: The Medicare Prescription Payment Plan lets you pay your drug costs in monthly amounts across the year instead of at the pharmacy. It does not lower your costs.
program.part_b_premium: You keep paying your Medicare Part B premium while you are in a Medicare Advantage plan.
program.emergency: Emergency care and urgently needed care are covered anywhere in the United States, in or out of network, without prior authorization.
